integrity: Exact all-length proof included. Standalone integer checker independently compared 349504 coefficients for lengths 3 through 9. No independent audit or historical uniqueness certification.
scientific_limitations: Applies to proper four-colourings with colour group F_2^2 and cycles of length at least three; identifies zeros, not every nonzero magnitude. One relevant preprint full text was inaccessible for historical comparison.
title: Complete Walsh nullity of four-colour cycle constraints over the Klein four-group
